jd:
We have an immediate opportunity for an organized undergraduate student to join our IT and Security team as AI & Operations Intern.

 

Our Intern will have an opportunity to accelerate their personal and professional growth through a professional learning environment.

 



About You
Under the direction of our VP of IT and Security, our Intern will add value and contribute to key IT and Security projects.

 

Duration:

 

We anticipate this position will work 40 hours per week and can be based in our Sunnyvale, CA office or remotely in the US.


What You'll Do (aka Responsibilities)


- Claude Skill Development Design, build, and test Claude skills (SKILL.md) for IT and Security workflows, including writing skill descriptions, step-by-step instructions, and prompt logic that integrates with Azul's connected MCP servers.

- AI Agent Design and Deployment Assist in scoping, building, and iterating on AI agents that automate repetitive IT and Security tasks, including tool selection, prompt engineering, and testing against real-world scenarios.

- MCP Connector Integration and Testing Configure and validate MCP connector integrations (Slack, Atlassian, Asana, M365, Salesforce) within Claude, documenting tool behavior and flagging gaps or security considerations.

- Security Operations Support Support the Security team with log review, alert triage, and incident documentation across Okta, Microsoft Purview, and Defender, following established investigation playbooks.

- IT Operations and Helpdesk Assistance Assist with hardware procurement tracking, onboarding/offboarding tasks, Jamf device management, and SaaS access requests under the direction of the IT Operations team.

- Documentation and Knowledge Base Maintenance Create and maintain internal documentation for AI tools, security procedures, and IT runbooks in Confluence, ensuring accuracy and accessibility for team members.


What You'll Bring (Education, Skills, Qualifications)


- Education:  Currently enrolled in an Undergraduate degree program majoring in Engineering, Information Technology, Physics or appropriate degree with a minimum overall GPA of 3.4

- Excellent organizational and time-management skills

- Able to effectively manage competing priorities

- Excellent written and verbal communication skills


Additional Details


- Duration:  8-12 weeks

- Weekly hours:  40

- Location:  Sunnyvale, CA or Remote, US




We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

We offer compensation where you’ll be rewarded based on your performance and recognized for the value you bring to the business.  The hourly pay for this job is $25.00.  Individual hourly pay is determined through a wide variety of factors including but not limited to education, experience, knowledge, skills and geography.
fit_why: IT/security ops with AI agents; partial overlap, lacks IT and security experience

At Manulife John Hancock, we believe in investing in the future – starting with you. Our co-op program is your launchpad to success, offering the support, structure, and exciting opportunities you need to thrive and make your mark.    

 As  a Software Engineering Co-op,  you’ll gain hands-on experience developing applications and systems that support business and customer solutions. You’ll work with modern development tools and frameworks to build scalable, high-quality software while contributing to the full software development lifecycle. We offer multiple roles within this program, providing support from our diverse, passionate, and talented technology teams.  You'll  receive guidance from skilled technical leaders who value your teamwork and coordination abilities, and gain exposure to industry-leading, enterprise technologies.    

 We are currently looking for highly motivated students to join us in our Toronto, Ontario, Canada office for a 4-month co-op , running from January 5 th – April 2 2 nd , 2027 . This is a hybrid position, where you are expected to be in the office Tuesday-Thursday, with the opportunity to work remotely on Mondays and Fridays.    

 Position Responsibilities:        

• Contribute to a team of engineers focused on building scalable, reliable applications   

• Support application development, testing, and debugging efforts   

• Assist in feature development and system enhancements   

• Collaborate with engineering and business teams to build user-focused solutions   

• Participate in code reviews and maintain code quality standards   

• Support deployment, monitoring, and ongoing application maintenanc e   

 Required Qualifications:       

• Currently pursuing an undergraduate degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field   

• Experience with at least one programming language (e.g., Java, Python, Go, JavaScript)   

• Familiarity with version control systems (e.g., Git, Bitbucket)   

• Strong communication skills and willingness to learn in a collaborative environment   

 Preferred Qualifications:     

• Exposure to software frameworks, libraries, or development tools   

• Understanding of software development lifecycle and best practices   

• Familiarity with APIs, web services, or application architecture   

 When you join our team:       

• We’ll  empower you to learn and grow the career you want.       

• We’ll  recognize and support you in a flexible environment where well-being and inclusion are more than just words.       

• As part of our global team,  we’ll  support you in shaping the future you want to see.       

• As part of our co-op program, you will gain  early access  to Manulife John Hancock’s premier early talent program, GRO, tailored to graduating students! This program is designed to launch your career with the support, structure, and opportunities you need to thrive.    

 Application instructions:      

• Submit your resume, cover letter, academic transcript, and work term evaluation (if any) in one PDF file.    

• Note: Applications are reviewed on a rolling basis.     

   Please note the salary range is expected to be between   $ 52,650 CAD to $70,200 CA D .   

 The actual salary will vary depending on local market conditions, geography and relevant job-related factors such as knowledge, skills, qualifications, experience, and education/training. The annual salary will be pro-rated based on the length of the work-term

jd:
Cloud Software Engineer Intern

Your Role 
 As a Cloud Software Engineering Intern, you will support the development of software solutions that operate in Linux-based and cloud environments. You will work closely with experienced engineers while gaining hands-on experience in software development, cloud technologies, and modern engineering practices.
  
 Responsibilities 
 ·  Support the design, development, testing, and maintenance of software applications and tools.
 ·  Develop and enhance software components using C and/or Python.
 ·  Work with Linux-based systems for development, debugging, and testing activities.
 ·  Collaborate with engineering teams to troubleshoot technical issues and improve software quality.
 ·  Contribute to projects related to cloud infrastructure and cloud-native technologies when applicable.
 ·  Participate in code reviews, team discussions, and knowledge-sharing sessions.
 ·  Document technical work and provide regular project updates.

 Your Background 
 
• Currently pursuing a Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related field. 
• Experience with software development projects through coursework, personal projects, research, internships, or extracurricular activities. 
• Knowledge of programming in C and/or Python. 
• Familiarity with Linux operating systems. 
• Exposure to cloud infrastructure or cloud technologies is a plus but not required. 
• Previous internship experience is preferred but not required. 
• Strong problem-solving, communication, and teamwork skills.  
 Why Join Aptiv / Wind River

You grow at Aptiv. 
 Aptiv's winning culture is global by design. We bring together diverse perspectives, cultures, and business contexts to solve our customers' toughest challenges. In this environment, every individual can grow, lead, and make an impact, regardless of background, because inclusion fuels how we innovate and win. 
 You make an impact at Aptiv. 
 One of the strengths of humanity is our drive to progress, to improve, to achieve more tomorrow than we did yesterday. People need solutions they can trust when it matters most. At Aptiv, you are building those solutions every day.
 You have support at Aptiv. 
 We ensure you have the resources and support you need to take care of your family, your physical health, and your mental health with a competitive benefits package.
    
 Your Benefits 
 
• Working in an international company that takes pride in a mission and vision, to make the world a safer, greener and better connected place 
• Opportunities to join social events, including sport groups and celebrations  
• Holiday Pay 
• Learning and development opportunities 
• Discount programs with various manufacturers and retailers 
• Recognition for innovation and excellence 
• Opportunities to give back to the community   
 Meet the Next-Generation Aptiv / Wind River 
 At Wind River, we deliver innovative solutions that people trust when it matters most. 
 
Progress is never static. It is about reaching further, exploring new possibilities, and enabling mobility. Wind River empowers customers to create solutions people rely on, advancing safety and autonomy in Automotive and Commercial Vehicles, enabling mission-critical performance in Aerospace & Defense, and powering intelligent systems across Energy, Enterprise, and Telecommunications. We also drive precision and efficiency in Industrials & Robotics and support life-critical innovation in Medical technologies.
 Guided by our winning culture and values to Think & Act Like Owners, as One Team, and Play to Win, we turn commitment into results and achieve more together.
  
 Join Us to Deliver Innovative Solutions That People Trust!
